definitions.usage: pass in beauty, be delight, be pleasant, be sweet.
definitions.full: H5276. naem I. [ נָעֵם ] verb be pleasant, delightful, lovely (Phoenician נעם good Lzb 324 (and many proper names); Arabic be plentiful, easy, pleasant ; shew gracious favour toward , often in Qoran; Sabean נעם be lovely, agreeable, well Levy-Os ZMG xix (1865), 178 CIS iv. 19, 11 ; so Minaean Hom Südar. Chrest. 128 ; Old Aramaic in proper name Lzb 222, 324 Cook 82 ( נעמתי my darling [or my songs , compare II. ׳נ ]); נָעִים ᵑ7 pleasant, lovely , נְעִימְתָּא loveliness ; Prä Bas i. 46 f. compare Ethiopic be pleasant , = ); — Qal Perfect 3feminine singular נָעֵ֑מָה Gen 49:15 (poem in J; of land); 2 masculine singular (of delightful friend) מְאֹד לִי נָעַמְתָּ 2Sam 1:26 , also (of physical beauty) נָעָ֑מְתָּ מִמִּי Ezek 32:19 ; 2 feminine singular ( id. ) מַהנָּֿעַמְתְּ Cant 7:7 how lovely art thou ! (|| מַהיָּֿפִית ); 3 plural, of pleasant words, נָעֵ֑מוּ Psa 141:6 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular יִנ ׳לְנַפְשְׁךָ ׃יִנְעָ֑ם Prov 2:10 (of knowledge); יִנ סְתָרִים ׳לֶחֶם 9:17 (|| יִמְתָּ֑קוּ ); ׳יִנ 24:25 is impersonal with ל , to them...shall be delight .

occurrences.englishText: He saw a resting place, that it was good,
I am distressed for you, my brother Jonathan.
Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock.
For wisdom will enter into your heart.
but it will go well with those who convict the guilty,
Whom do you pass in beauty? Go down, and be laid with the uncircumcised.
